text.en: Complete chapter index Look up every chapter of theory, derivations and worked examples, plus learning resources, by field. The learning guide suggests an order of study. This index covers every chapter and resource in 10 categories. The learning guide’s field map is a separate view of suggested paths. Look up a method’s conditions, code and checks: All methods Numerical foundations: a 19-chapter beginner course Matching English and Japanese Web/PDF courses with shared figures, small verified examples, and 38 review questions with answers. Foundations, error and time integration Start with error and stability, then follow time integration and equations with constraints.
